underlying_release: libxml2 2.15.4 and PHP 8.5.12 ext/dom Dom\XMLDocument::createFromString (AFL++ overlay, source build); Ubuntu PHP 8.5.4 with libxml 2.15.2 via php8.5-xml (Xdebug coverage image)
coverage_limit: Xdebug line coverage sees only veewee/xml PHP lines (xml_decode, the Dom\XMLDocument string loader and error handling, and the Encoding decoder's array builders) and is reported separately; php-standard-library and webmozart/assert lines are excluded. AFL++ feedback comes from the native overlay: libxml2 2.15.4 parser.c, parserInternals.c and SAX2.c plus PHP 8.5.12 ext/dom/xml_document.c and document.c, instrumented through an allowlist while the same xml_decode harness runs; ext/dom/namespace_compat.c, ext/libxml, libxml2 tree code and the interpreted veewee/xml code add no AFL++ tuples, so the veewee/xml lines that differ between the controls are visible only in the Xdebug report. The pinned base image does not bundle php-fuzzer; replay is per case.
coverage: Xdebug executed line coverage in veewee/xml 4.14.0 PHP source (src/Xml/) during valid namespace-aware XML decode; AFL++ feedback comes from the allowlisted libxml2 XML parser and PHP ext/dom Dom\XMLDocument loading sources in the native overlay
